title: Jonah Part 2
textBlocks:
Today we will hear that how 
GOD 
SAVED JONAH AND SENT A BIG FISH

GOD HEARS US - GOD HELPS US

The Lord saved Jonah by sending a BIG FISH to swallow him and take him back to the beach.
Jonah was in the BIG FISH for 3 days and 3 nights
While Jonah was in the belly he prayed to the Lord

Dear Lord 
Thank you for saving us and for listening to us
and hearing our prayers

Matthew 12:40
For as Jonah was in the belly of the great fish for three days and three nights….
